chunks: And also Aḥmad narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh al-Barqī, from Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from al-Ḥasan ibn Abī Sārah, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh: If something of wine touches my garment, may I perform salat (prayer) in it before washing it? He said, “There is no harm; indeed, the garment does not become intoxicated.”

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or problem

ai.seo_question: Can I perform salat (prayer) in clothes that have been touched by wine before washing them?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling on praying in a garment that has been touched by wine. The Imam عليه السلام states that there is no problem in praying in it, indicating that the garment itself is not rendered unfit for salat (prayer) merely by contact with wine in this report.
